name: EPIC 220272081
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 14.3 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220272081 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.346357 (16th-84th percentiles 13.91899-15.014465), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,235 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.85 solar masses and 14.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,500 K at its surface.
